nodes.label: P&L in SOL and USD
nodes.rationale: SOL price comes from CoinGecko rather than Jupiter so reporting never consumes the trading request budget. Always split SIMULATED vs REAL so paper results can't be mistaken for money.

nodes.label: Thin-Token Route Loss
nodes.rationale: Very new or thin tokens can lose their Jupiter route within seconds; the bot retries sells but a successful exit is never guaranteed. Only trade SOL you can lose.

nodes.label: Abandoned Position
nodes.rationale: A position sold outside the bot (Phantom, jup.ag) reads as zero balance on-chain; it is marked abandoned (not stuck, nothing left to retry), frees its MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS slot, and records no P&L because the bot never saw the sale price.

nodes.label: Manual Write-off
nodes.rationale: For a token still held but judged worthless (rugged, no route). Frees its slot without recording P&L. Only touches real open/stuck positions, never simulated or closed ones.

nodes.label: Stuck Position
nodes.rationale: A real sell that fails after retries is marked STUCK ('tokens still in your wallet'), flagged loudly, excluded from realized P&L, still counts toward MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS, and gets one more try on shutdown. Never faked as closed.

nodes.label: Copy Rules
nodes.rationale: One position per token; sells are only mirrored from the same wallet whose buy was copied; a tracked sell of more than 90% of their bag is treated as a full exit.

nodes.label: Graceful Shutdown
nodes.rationale: First Ctrl+C stops watching immediately, then closes all positions. A second Ctrl+C only force-quits after 5 seconds so a key-repeat or impatient double-tap can't cut a real sell short. Sells never run twice.

nodes.label: Real Sells Sized From Wallet
nodes.rationale: A fill delivers slightly less than quoted (slippage), so selling the quoted figure is rejected as 'Insufficient funds' and strands the position. The actual on-chain balance is read before every real sell.

nodes.label: Copy Trading
nodes.rationale: Mirror a tracked wallet's buys with a small FIXED amount of SOL (never their size) and mirror their sells by the same fraction. Predictable exposure regardless of how big the tracked wallet trades.

nodes.label: .env Configuration
nodes.rationale: All tunables live in .env: wallet, RPC URLs, Jupiter key, tracked wallets, DRY_RUN, buy size, max positions, dust filter, reserve, slippage, RPC pace, notifications, summary interval.

nodes.label: Offline Logic Tests
nodes.rationale: npm test runs with no wallet, no network and a throwaway keypair in a temp folder; verifies detection, limiter spacing, stuck handling, the double-Ctrl+C guard and that P&L never invents numbers.

nodes.label: Phantom Wallet Key
nodes.rationale: Either a base58 private key exported from Phantom or the 12/24-word recovery phrase at derivation path m/44'/501'/0'/0'. Kept in .env, which is gitignored.

nodes.label: Position Persistence
nodes.rationale: Positions are saved in data/positions.json and survive restarts; rm -rf data forgets them without selling anything.

nodes.label: Troubleshooting Guide
nodes.rationale: Maps each startup/runtime symptom (config error, wallet error, Helius unreachable, Jupiter 429s, RPC retries, stale skips, no route, idle bot) to its fix.

nodes.label: Buy/Sell Detection Rules
nodes.rationale: Compare the tracked wallet's balances before and after each confirmed transaction: exactly one non-quote token up while SOL/USDC/USDT down = buy; the reverse = sell; anything else (transfers, airdrops, LP, multi-token swaps) is skipped.

nodes.label: DRY_RUN Mode
nodes.rationale: Default on. Real Jupiter quotes are fetched but no transaction is ever sent until DRY_RUN=false is set explicitly, so behaviour can be watched safely first.

nodes.label: Hard Caps
nodes.rationale: Fixed SOL per buy, max simultaneous positions (stuck ones count), a minimum SOL reserve real trades never dip below, and a dust filter on tiny tracked buys.

nodes.label: Mark to Market
nodes.rationale: npm run summary prices open positions with quote-only Jupiter orders (no taker, so no balance check) and flags NO ROUTE tokens. The in-run periodic summary is deliberately NOT marked to market because the 1 req/s budget belongs to trading.

nodes.label: Shared Jupiter Rate Limiter
nodes.rationale: The free Jupiter tier allows 1 request/second, so ONE limiter sits in front of every Jupiter call: max 1 in flight, ~1.1s between calls.
